name: How should a homeowner prepare before an interior restoration maintenance inspection?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before an interior restoration maintenance inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an estimate, document all visible damage, note historical water issues, and clear the work zone of personal items and fragile decor. Take clear photographs of damaged baseboards, stained ceilings, or cracked tiles, and note any strange odors or drafts in the room. If insurance is involved from storm or pipe issues, have your adjuster notes or claims documentation ready for the contractor to review. Ensuring clear access to electrical panels, main water shut-offs, and crawl spaces helps the contractor inspect framing and utilities without unnecessary delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Document the issues with photos, clear furniture away from damaged walls or trim, and locate utility shut-offs and any relevant insurance documentation.
